item.title: Nyuuin Byoutou ~Do S Nurse de Mugen Zecchou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Peony
  • 発売日: 2018-04-27
  • スコア: 5.93/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 入淫病棟 ～ドSナースで無限絶頂～
  • 英語名: Nyuuin Byoutou Do S Nurse de Mugen Zecchou

あらすじ

Sho has been admitted to the hospital after a car accident that left him in a life-or-death situation.

Unable to even eat by himself, Sho needs the help of the nurses to do anything.

Taking advantage of this, the girls begin to play around with him…!!

He cannot stand up for himself against these approaching girls, nor is he allowed to run away.

item.title: Ore wa Jukujo Kyouai Shugi ~Yokkyuu Fuman na Hitozuma Hodo Ochiyasui~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Peony
  • 発売日: 2017-10-27
  • スコア: 5.67/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 俺は熟女狂愛主義 ～欲求不満な人妻ほど堕ちやすい～
  • 英語名: Ore wa Jukujo Kyouai Shugi Yokkyuu Fuman na Hitozuma Hodo Ochiyasui

あらすじ

Protagonist lost his parents when he was a child.

The protagonist lived his days in isolation, never experiencing the kindness of human beings.

One day, he succumbed to heat stroke and fainted. Receiving kindness from that episode, he met Aika.

For the protagonist, who lived in solitude, she was like a goddess.
